searchText: I've started another round of heavy spamming on devnet-7 will leave it running 24 hours seems to have taken besu nodes out <https://dora.glamsterdam-devnet-7.ethpandaops.io/> cc <@764128349488152606> > besu: world state never persisted after block import — regression in `16c6fae77` "Stateroot modification glamsterdam devnet 7" > + (#10869); 4/6 prod besu nodes wedged (NOT caused by the spam increase) Yes, I just saw that, I have a node running with the previous commit without issues. <@680337202521440470> could you take a look ? Could you rollback to ethpandaops/besu:glamsterdam-devnet-7-caa5abf while investigating from our side ? rolled back. The database is corrupted, we need to resync the nodes. ok lighthouse-besu-1 is sync'ing yeah kicked all of them hmm might need some fancy assertoor logic for this but it could be doable Seems mostly teku is still self building even though they should have a higher bid from buildoor <@993802539856314398> I'm trying to win and withold every 31st slot why slot 31 btw? what exactly do you wanna test? that was suggested as a test vector here but I guess you'd want the whole slot missing not just the payload? yeah whole slot missing is important so that the dependent root is actually not slot 31 so blocks in slot 31 being reorged should trigger some untested paths I don't really see what the payload missing would do, it has no impact on epoch transition (thanks to 5094) but slot 31 being reorged is nasty, but also clients don't do this today even if head is weak Yes agree, that's why I want to test slot 31 skipped/orphaned Even every such slot for a while We are becoming more and more dependent on dependent root now at the consensus level with this root being propagated on p2p I believe this is under tested why does skipped matter? I am wondering if I can force deathstar to do this, eg. I can make it build on the parent if it's proposer of slot 31 even if head is strong, that should cause a reorg most likely, ~~although proposer boost reorg is not enabled by default across epoch boundaries, so we need deathstar to also be proposer of slot 0?~~ ah no not relevant, will try and see if I can add that feature From the point of view of the chain it's skipped but the node may have it. I'm interested in both cases, not only the one you are going to trigger but the one in which slot 31 gets reorged, that is 31 is head but it comes late and then slot 0 reorgs it. I believe lighthouse may reorg these now cc <@602753420033785856> <@358120958726373381> but I think we still avoid these reorgs so to clarify, you want it to become head at slot 31 but slot 0 proposer reorgs it and build on slot 30? so in that case only hope is lighthouse if they do that reorg or I can add that to lodestar to do such reorgs Yeah or I can modify Prysm quickly to reorg those as well I am adding a feature to deathstar to propose late in slot 31, then we can see what happens So death star can have two modes: delay 31 or build on parent in 31 looks like `lodestar-besu-1` is stuck due to EL, keeping it in the current state to allow debugging ``` MergeCoordinator | Could not persist world for root hash 0x8290…cd64b ``` is this happening in a node in particular or all teku ones?
